scene: The brass sidecar rattles smoothly past cavernous depot shelves into darkness.
beats: Warm saxophone music bursts from the speaker as the bike skids to a neat halt. Midnight Radio Repair's glowing doorway slides wide open beside you.
The courier beeps pleasantly and hands you a spare vacuum tube. The bike rolls to a halt, and Midnight Radio Repair's workshop doors slide open.
You find a glowing frequency chart inside and fold it neatly away. The engine cuts as the sidecar glides inside, the workshop doors sliding open wide.
picture: Pixel art flat side view. On a dark street line, a motorcycle with attached brass sidecar speeds rightward. On the far left, a sleek robot courier steers. Centre, the player sits bundled in the sidecar beside a copper dial. To the right, a latched glove box. Depot shelves blur past outside.
shown: a crackling copper radio dial set on the sidecar console at centre
the leather-jacketed robotic courier steering the motorbike on the far left
a tiny brass latch shut on a dashboard compartment to the right

after.beat: You zoom past the repair shop, ducking under a fluttering laundry line. At the terminus you hop into a rumbling tow truck, pulling up outside the buzzing, colourful Neon Sign Hospital.
after.then: Step off at Neon Sign Hospital

variants.scene: You cruise through dimly lit depot tunnels in the steady, polished brass sidecar.
beats: Lively horn melodies crackle out across the rushing breeze as you pull up. Midnight Radio Repair's bright doors glide apart before you.
Your guide chirps in greeting, passing back a glass valve. The motorcycle slows to a stop, and Midnight Radio Repair's entrance rolls open.
A folded paper map of broadcast bands sits inside, pocketed with care. The motor softly purrs to silence as the repair shop doors slide apart.
variants.ride_on: You speed past the workshop, dodging damp clotheslines overhead. Trading the sidecar for a clattering tow truck at the terminus, you reach the buzzing, vibrant Neon Sign Hospital.

variants.scene: The motor hums softly as shadows slip across towering stacks of wooden crates.
beats: Sweet brass notes fill the chilly tunnel air. With a smooth slide, the bike stops, and the repair shop's glowing entryway slides open.
The mechanical driver offers an encouraging click and a glass tube. The vehicle settles to a halt, and Midnight Radio Repair's front doors slide open.
Tucked within is a bright wavelength guide that you tuck safely away. The journey ends smoothly as the workshop's tall entrance slides open wide.
variants.ride_on: Whizzing right past the stop, you duck under flapping linens. You switch into a noisy tow truck at the depot terminus, pulling up beside the humming Neon Sign Hospital.

variants.scene: Cool basement air rushes past your collar as you search for {quest}.
beats: A cheerful saxophone tune rings through the dashboard speaker as the wheels brake. Midnight Radio Repair's illuminated doors slide quietly open.
The robot beeps kindly, handing you a glowing spare component. The ride brakes smoothly, and Midnight Radio Repair's wide doors part for you.
You slide out an illuminated sheet of radio channels for safekeeping. The engine shuts down right as the repair shop entrance slides wide open.
variants.ride_on: Skipping your stop, you glide under strung-up sheets. At the terminus you climb into a rumbling yellow tow truck, coasting directly toward the dazzling Neon Sign Hospital.
